div.class: o_envcare_fab_stack position-fixed d-flex flex-column-reverse align-items-center gap-3

a.t-attf-class: btn #{fab.get('class') or 'btn-primary'} rounded-circle shadow d-flex align-items-center justify-content-center p-0

t.div: You can select several files at once.

th.t-att-class: 'text-end' if col['type'] in ('int', 'float') and not allow_edit else 'text-center' if col['type'] == 'bool' else None

div.div: Tick the box at the end of a row to delete it.

input.t-att-value: value if value not in (None, False, '') else ''

td.t-att-class: 'text-end' if ctype in ('int', 'float') else 'text-center' if ctype == 'bool' else None

i.t-attf-class: fa #{'fa-check text-success' if value else 'fa-minus text-muted'}

div.label: Send to
div.div: Hold Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) to pick several people. An e-mail goes to the people you pick, to you and to the owners (). Nobody needs to follow the event.

div.span: Shown as an internal note on the event.

div.label: Send to
div.div: Hold Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) to pick several people. An e-mail goes to the people you pick, to you and to the owners (). Nobody needs to follow the event.

div.span: Shown as a message on the event.

input.name: summary
input.placeholder: e.g. Call the venue about chairs

div.label: Assign to
div.div: Hold Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) to pick several people. Only they get a reminder, at the chosen time.

div.span: The selected people get an e-mail reminder at this time (nothing is sent before).

span.t-attf-class: rounded-circle d-inline-flex align-items-center justify-content-center text-white flex-shrink-0 #{'bg-danger' if act['state'] == 'overdue' else 'bg-warning' if act['state'] == 'today' else 'bg-success'}
badge ms-1 #{'bg-danger' if act['state'] == 'overdue' else 'bg-warning' if act['state'] == 'today' else 'bg-success'}

span.class: rounded-circle bg-secondary text-white d-inline-flex align-items-center justify-content-center flex-shrink-0

div.t-attf-class: mt-1 p-2 rounded #{'bg-light' if msg['kind'] == 'note' else 'border'}

span.t-attf-class: badge #{'bg-info' if event.status == 'draft' else 'bg-success' if event.status == 'live' else 'bg-warning'}

div.label: Documents
div.div: You can select several files at once.
Leave Start / End empty to use the event's dates. Tick the box at the end of a row to delete that workshop.
You can view this workshop, but not change it.
This workshop is canceled. Switch off Canceled and save to edit it again.
Leave Start / End empty to use the event's dates.

div.label: Sevaks
div.div: Hold Ctrl (Cmd on Mac) to pick several. The Lead and Deputy are always added.
A canceled workshop can only be changed by IT / Admin.

tr.t-if: not (workshop and workshop.items_ids) and not can_edit_fields

div.div: Availability is worked out from the stock on hand after saving. Tick the box at the end of a row to delete that item.
